text.p: These are the leading stories in Zimbabwe's state-owned Herald newspaper on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Zimbabwe and South Africa on Tuesday signed a memorandum of understanding expected to facilitate the resumption of trade on a quota basis in all agricultural products previously covered by the now obsolete 1964 trade pact between the two countries.

- A Business and Investment Forum of the Group of 15 developing countries ended in Harare on Tuesday with a call for the private sector in member states to be active in the development of the organisation.

- Developing economies should efficiently manage and fully utilise domestic resources to achieve growth and development, South Africa's trade and industry minister said on Wednesday when he officially opened the annual congress of Zimbabwe's Commercial Farmers Union in Harare.
